title: Summarising and Paraphrasing
ringkas: Menulis ulang dengan kata sendiri tanpa mengubah makna
goals: menulis ulang kalimat dengan **kata dan struktur berbeda** tanpa mengubah makna
memilih **ringkasan yang tepat** untuk sebuah teks

lesson.text: **Paraphrase** berarti mengubah kalimat dengan kata sendiri tanpa mengubah makna. **Summary** berarti mengambil gagasan utama saja dalam bentuk singkat. Keduanya penting dalam ujian dan tulisan akademik. Jangan menyalin kalimat apa adanya.

lesson.title: 1. Cara memparafrase
table: [[Although it rained, we went. → We went although it rained.]]
angka, nama, dan fakta tidak boleh berubah

examples.en: [[The city has a large population. → Many people live in the city.]]
examples.id: Kota itu berpenduduk banyak. → Banyak orang tinggal di kota itu.

lesson.title: 2. Cara meringkas
table: Periksa: lebih pendek, makna utama sama

lesson.title: Paraphrase bukan sekadar mengganti satu kata
lesson.text: Mengganti satu kata saja masih dianggap menyalin. Ubah juga struktur kalimatnya.

items: Paraphrase: ganti kata dan struktur, makna sama.

practice.q: Pilih parafrase terbaik: "The city has a large population."
options: Many people live in the city.
The city has a large population.

practice.q: Pilih parafrase terbaik: "She bought a new phone."
Pilih parafrase terbaik: "The teacher explained the lesson."
options: The lesson was explained by the teacher.

practice.q: Pilih parafrase terbaik: "Although it was cold, we went swimming."
options: We went swimming even though it was cold.
We did not go swimming because it was cold.
It was cold, so we went swimming.
Because it was hot, we swam.

practice.q: Pilih parafrase terbaik: "He decided to leave."
options: He made a decision to leave.

practice.q: Pilih parafrase terbaik: "Many students find maths difficult."
options: Maths is hard for many students.
Maths is easy for many students.

practice.q: Pilih ringkasan terbaik untuk: "Recycling reduces waste, saves energy, and protects nature. For example, recycling one can saves enough energy to run a TV for three hours."
options: Recycling is beneficial because it reduces waste and saves energy.
Recycling one can runs a TV for three hours.

practice.q: Pilih ringkasan terbaik untuk: "The town has a market, a library, and two schools. Most people work in farming. In the evening, the streets are quiet."
options: It is a small farming town with basic services.
The town has two schools and a market.

practice.q: Pilih parafrase yang SALAH makna: "The shop closes at nine."
options: Nine o'clock is closing time for the shop.

practice.q: Apa yang harus dijaga saat memparafrase?
practice.exp: Jaga makna. Jawaban yang tepat: **makna, angka, dan fakta**.

practice.q: The lesson was ___ by the teacher.
We swam even ___ it was cold.
